constraints: Review-only scratch intake. Both long and short; completed-bar signals; next-bar-open fills; one position; no pyramiding. Long: EMA(trend_fast)>EMA(200), close>EMA(200), and close crosses above EMA(pullback). Short: exact inverse. Exit long when close crosses below EMA(pullback); exit short when close crosses above; also use ATR(14) exit with multiplier parameter and a maximum-holding parameter. Fixed 10-bar entry cooldown. Free parameters only: pullback_ema_bars [10,20,30] default 20; trend_fast_ema_bars [40,50,60] default 50; atr_multiplier [2.0,2.5,3.0] default 2.5; max_holding_bars [30,45,60] default 45. Fixed slow EMA=200 and ATR lookback=14. Require pullback<trend_fast<200. Fees 4bps, slippage 2bps, funding accounted. No volatility-percentile filter, SMA crossover entry, take profit, adaptive sizing, live data, execution authority, or promotion.
input.idea: H-004-R2 daily EMA pullback continuation with ATR and time-stop risk containment. Because slow information diffusion and persistent investor positioning can sustain multi-week BTC momentum, a temporary countertrend pullback toward a short EMA may create a lower-risk continuation entry after price recovers inside an established EMA trend. On completed BTCUSDT daily OHLCV bars, enter long when close crosses above a pullback EMA while a faster trend EMA is above a fixed 200-day EMA and price is above the 200-day EMA; mirror the logic for shorts. Exit on a pullback EMA recross, a fixed ATR exit, or a bounded maximum holding period. The falsifiable prediction is improved net Sharpe, maximum drawdown, and 90-day PnL concentration relative to the concluded H-004 baseline after fees, slippage, and funding.
